SIX-BOX (NUMBERS): (1) TRAJECTORY iter->ssim/psnr/rmse/hr: 1(relax0.5,it0.7,eta1)->0.7220/27.35/1.465e-2/0; 2(relax1,it0.7)->0.8199/27.62/1.420e-2/0; 3(it0.4)->0.8946/27.93/1.371e-2/0 [RMSE MIN]; 4(it0.2)->0.9089/27.89/1.377e-2/0. iter-4 FALSIFIER FIRED: init_t 0.4->0.2 RAISED RMSE (1.371->1.377e-2) and dropped PSNR -> init_t bottomed at 0.4 (SSIM keeps rising toward FBP but RMSE plateaued). (2) FAILURE MODE: dc_relax (1.0) and init_t (0.4) axes are both saturated; PSNR pinned ~8.4dB below the ~36.3 FBP baseline -> hr=0. Remaining prior-injection source: per-step DPS guidance (fd_recon_eta) steers x_t down the gradient of the sinogram residual THROUGH the mis-scaled clean estimate, so the 10x out_scale mismatch corrupts the guidance direction. (3) ONE KNOB: fd_recon_eta 1.0 -> 0.5 (halve DPS guidance so the mis-scaled score contributes less per step; the hard CG DC-step at relax1.0 still enforces measurement consistency). init_t RESET to its RMSE-optimal 0.4 (NOT 0.2); all else identical to iter-3 (steps8, dc1, n_cg5, relax1.0). (4) HYPOTHESIS: eta 1.0->0.5 cuts RMSE below iter-3's 1.371e-2 because reducing the mis-scaled DPS steering lets the DC-anchored FBP structure dominate with less prior-HU corruption. FALSIFIER: if RMSE >= 1.371e-2 (eta inert/worse), DPS guidance is not the limiter and the residual gap is the intrinsic DC-cleaned-FBP-vs-FBP-baseline floor (a zero-shot Mayo-prior recon on breast cannot beat the breast FBP it is scored against) -> the fastdiff-family structural hr=0 verdict on breast is established; iters 6-20 sweep the remaining recon knobs (fd_recon_steps NFE, eta finer, init_t finer, n_cg) to bracket the ceiling and confirm robustness. (5) BUDGET: eta is FREE (same 8 steps/CG5, init_t0.4); runtime ~iter-3 160s, well inside 1200s / 1800s kill. val=ALL 200 seed-20260703 cases. (6) Loop continues.
